What is the relationship between X and Y?

You will see pairs of academic variables. Your job is to classify the relationship between each pair.

Background on lexical relationships: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypernymy_and_hyponymy

Options

Same — The two variables refer to the same underlying construct, just worded differently. Example: firm size vs organization size.

X is more specific than/is a type of Y — X is a subtype, subcase, or narrower instance of Y. Example: CEO tenure is a subtype of executive tenure because there are different kinds of executives. For example, executive tenure could also describe the length of time the CFO remains in their job.

X is more general than/encompasses Y — X encompasses or subsumes Y. Example: job attitudes encompasses job satisfaction because there are different possible attitudes towards a job. For example, professionalism is a kind of job attitude. Job attitudes encompasses professionalism.

None of the above — The variables are simply different constructs.

Tips

When in doubt, choose None of the above.
